items.title: Who is the real prime minister?
items.blurb: After the IGP removal and journalist detentions, Lamichhane’s claim of a right to intervene has reopened a question the RSP’s landslide was meant to settle.

items.title: US to resume flights after air traffic network failure sparks chaos
items.blurb: A communications failure at air traffic control centres grounded flights nationwide for four hours, disrupting thousands of journeys and exposing vulnerabilities in the ageing US aviation system.

items.title: For Mamta Kafle’s family, a guilty verdict is not enough
items.blurb: A US jury convicted Naresh Bhatt of murdering his wife, whose body remains missing. Her family and advocates say the case highlights the difficulties Nepali women face in leaving abusive relationships abroad.

items.title: Chitwan beat Janakpur to strengthen playoff hopes
items.blurb: Chitwan recovered from a shaky start to chase down a target of 89 with four wickets to spare, leaving Janakpur’s playoff hopes hanging in the balance.

items.title: Janakpur collapse against Chitwan in must-win match
items.blurb: The first-season champions managed just 88 for nine, dealing a major blow to their slim hopes of reaching the Nepal Premier League playoffs.

items.title: Community forests turn to tourism, but potential remains untapped
items.blurb: Jeep, elephant and boat safaris bring in millions for some forests but most of Chitwan’s 93 forests outside the park buffer zone have yet to follow suit.
